item.title: 6 Steam Games To Wishlist That Aren't GTA 6
item.description: This week, players are finally able to get their hands on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While Rockstar’s gigantic open-world is sure to keep players occupied for a very long time, it’s certainly not the last video game that will ever be released. There are plenty of promising games on the horizon beyond GTA 6 .

item.title: All main story missions in GTA 6
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a big game, and that extends to its story. It features the longest campaign of any GTA game by a wide margin, taking well over 50 hours to complete even at a rushed rate. If you’re looking for an easy way to keep track of your progress as you play, we’ve got all the details you need.

item.title: GTA 6 Sets New Sales Record for Rockstar Just One Day In
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 was setting records before it was even released . Now that it's out, don't expect that pace to slow down anytime soon. New estimates suggest GTA 6 is not just the fastest-selling video game ever, but the fastest-selling piece of entertainment ever.

item.title: GTA 6 Cast List: Who plays Jason, Lucia and More
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has the longest story ever seen in a GTA game, which also means that it has an enormous cast of characters. Between rival faction leaders, radio station DJs, and fictional rappers, you're going to meet a whole lot of people in Leonida. And some of their voices might sound very familiar.

item.title: How to change radio stations in GTA 6
item.description: You need to know how to change radio in Grand Theft Auto 6 if you want to explore the vast array of music the game has to offer, and trust me, GTA 6 has a lot of songs. Whether you're partial to some country as you cruise Leonida's highways, perhaps some classical to accompany you in the skies, or heavy metal to fuel your workout, you can change radio stations whenever you like, as long as you're near a radio.

item.title: Should you spare or kill Arnold for 'Hey Arnold' in GTA 6?
item.description: Deciding whether to spare or kill Arnold in Grand Theft Auto 6 's "Hey Arnold" quest is one of your first big branching decisions in the game. It seems like a big one, though while it will influence certain aspects of your playthrough, it doesn't dramatically alter how the story unfolds. Brian doesn't even care how you get the job done. He just wants to know it's done so he can carry on with his job.

item.title: Persona 7 Already Teased Before Persona 6 Has an Official Release Date
item.description: Now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is actually out and playable, we can no longer make "we really got X before GTA 6 " jokes. Seemingly to make up for that loss, Atlus is giving us the opportunity to use the very same joke for Persona 6 . The next mainline entry in the beloved RPG series was finally revealed this year, a decade after Persona 5 launched, but there is no sign of a release date. Even so, one Atlus producer is already giving fans hope for Persona 7 .

item.title: Hunger Games Director Reveals Why He Made the Darkest Movie in Franchise History
item.description: “I found myself playing music that is a lot scarier,” Lawrence tells Polygon. That included the soundtrack from the modern horror classic, Midsommar. "Some of what I was listening to is actually some tracks from that movie.”

item.title: How to save in GTA 6
item.description: Unless you're keeping the game suspended while your console sleeps, you need to know how to save in Grand Theft Auto 6 . This is the sort of game where not saving can undo hours of progress, which is absolutely gutting when it happens. There are also questions about the GTA 6 autosave function and how it works, which we can also help explain.

item.title: GTA 6 Learned All the Right Lessons From Zelda: Breath of the Wild
item.description: Throwing players into an open-world game can be challenging. When your game has an enormous map, you risk giving players almost too much freedom up front. There’s a very careful art in helping players get acclimated to how exploration works in a game without totally restricting any sense of exploration. The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild famously nailed the art of an open-world introduction in 2017 with its meticulously crafted starting area, the Great Plateau. Now, nearly a decade later, Grand Theft Auto 6 has pulled off the same trick.
